views.purpose: The diagram targets the user registration functionality by illustrating runtime components and their connectors, answering the questions regarding main components, control flow, and connectivity for integration testing.
required_evidence: runtime components involved in user registration
connectors and communication paths between components
sequence of calls between parts during account creation
views.diagram_language_rule: viewpoint agent chose plantuml: PlantUML can effectively depict runtime components, connectors, and communication paths required to answer the connectivity and control-flow questions for integration testing.

notes: Eligible because they frame the chosen concerns: module-decomposition, context, cnc-runtime, code-mapping

module-decomposition and code-mapping were rejected because they focus on static structure and maintainability rather than runtime interaction and connectivity; context was rejected because it operates at too high a boundary level and does not show the internal runtime components and connectors needed for integration testing.

diagram language plantuml: viewpoint agent chose plantuml: PlantUML can effectively depict runtime components, connectors, and communication paths required to answer the connectivity and control-flow questions for integration testing.
